Identified family members including mother, father, sister, and grandmother.
Recognised that families can have different members and sizes.
Discussed caring actions such as giving medicine and water.
Discussed household work; Trisha suggested putting away books.
The idea that children can help with family work was not fully corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised different family structures and why sharing household work helps. Trisha gave examples of family care, and suggested putting away books as a child’s contribution. The mix-up that only grown-ups can help remained at the end; at home, invite Trisha to choose one small regular task, such as arranging books.
